definitions.def: Permittivity is the property of a medium which affects the magnitude of force between two point charges.
This relation provides us with the definition of relative permittivity or dielectric constant or specific inductive capacity.

The electric flux is denoted by \(\Phi_E\). For uniform field \(\vec E\) and area \(\vec A\) electric flux is defined as the measure of number of lines of force that pass through the area placed in the electric field. Flux \(\Phi_E\) is the scalar product of the electric field E and plane surface area A.
Gauss’ law states that the net electric flux through a closed surface is equal to the total charge \(q\) enclosed by the surface divided by the permittivity of free space.
Potential difference between two points is the work done in moving a unit positive charge from one point to another keeping the charge in electrostatic equilibrium.
Thus the electric potential at any point is equal to the work done in bringing a unit positive charge from infinity to that point without producing any acceleration.
The rate of change of electric potential \(\Delta V\) with respect to displacement \(\Delta r\) is known as potential gradient.
The surfaces which have equal electrostatic potential at each point are known as Equipotential Surfaces.

The electron-volt is a unit of energy or work which is defined as the amount of energy acquired or lost by an electron when it is displaced across two points between which potential difference is one volt.
A device which is used for storing electric charges is called capacitor.
The capacitance is thus defined as the ratio of magnitude of charge on either plate to the potential difference produced between the plates.
Farad (F) is defined as “the capacity of that capacitor which stores a charge of 1 coulomb having the potential difference of 1 volt between the plates”.

In the previous section we explored the dependence of charge storing capacity of a capacitor on the dielectric material. A dielectric is an electrical insulator that can be polarized by an applied electric field.

The system in which two charges of equal magnitude but of opposite sign separated by the distance d, are present is termed as a dipole. Electric dipole moment is represented by P, which is equal to the product of the charge Q present in the dipole and the distance d between the two charges of the dipole.

definitions.definition: The time taken to charge a capacitor in a given circuit is determined by the time constant of the circuit. The factor RC is called the time constant. The time constant is the duration of time for the capacitor in which 63.2% of its maximum value charge is deposited on the plates, as illustrated in the curve in Figure 11.28.

problems.question: Three capacitors of capacitance \(4\,\mu\mathrm F\), \(6\,\mu\mathrm F\), and \(8\,\mu\mathrm F\), respectively, are connected in series to a \(250\,\mathrm V\) d.c. supply. Find (i) the total capacitance, (ii) the charge on each capacitor, and (iii) the potential difference across each capacitor.
problems.questionUrdu: \(4\,\mu\mathrm F\)، \(6\,\mu\mathrm F\) اور \(8\,\mu\mathrm F\) گنجائش کے تین کیپیسٹر بالترتیب سلسلہ وار \(250\,\mathrm V\) ڈی سی منبع سے جڑے ہیں۔ معلوم کریں: (i) کل گنجائش، (ii) ہر کیپیسٹر پر بار، اور (iii) ہر کیپیسٹر کے آرپار فرقِ پوٹینشل۔
problems.questionPashto: د \(4\,\mu\mathrm F\)، \(6\,\mu\mathrm F\) او \(8\,\mu\mathrm F\) ظرفیت لرونکي درې کپاسیټرونه په لړۍ کې له \(250\,\mathrm V\) ډي‌سي سرچینې سره نښتي دي. ومومئ: (i) ټول ظرفیت، (ii) پر هر کپاسیټر چارج، او (iii) د هر کپاسیټر پر سر پوتنشیالي توپیر.

problems.question: A \(6\,\mu\mathrm F\) capacitor is charged to a potential difference of \(120\,\mathrm V\) and then connected to an uncharged \(4\,\mu\mathrm F\) capacitor. Calculate the potential difference across the capacitors.
problems.questionUrdu: \(6\,\mu\mathrm F\) کیپیسٹر کو \(120\,\mathrm V\) فرقِ پوٹینشل تک چارج کر کے غیر باردار \(4\,\mu\mathrm F\) کیپیسٹر سے جوڑا جاتا ہے۔ کیپیسٹروں کے آرپار فرقِ پوٹینشل معلوم کریں۔
problems.questionPashto: \(6\,\mu\mathrm F\) کپاسیټر تر \(120\,\mathrm V\) پوتنشیالي توپیر پورې چارج شوی او بیا له بې‌چارج \(4\,\mu\mathrm F\) کپاسیټر سره نښلول کېږي. د کپاسیټرونو پر سر پوتنشیالي توپیر ومومئ.
